text:
maria: Deploybot just flagged a canary P95 latency spike for v3.7.0 — 2.3s over baseline and some 502s. autopilot recommends revert. change window ends in ~40m, cc @oncall :eyes:
deploybot: [AUTOMATED] Canary checks: p95_latency=2300ms (threshold 1500ms), error_rate=0.8% (baseline 0.05%). Suggested action: auto-revert to last stable (v3.6.5). To approve run `/deploy revert --auto v3.6.5`
leo: seeing the same in eu-canary. also noticed KV cache miss ratio jumped after the kernel flag. looks correlated to recent kvcache change. 502s are coming from the routing layer.
ashley: +1 to correlate with kernel flag. if we auto-revert we should also pin routing to v3.6.5 so a noisy rollout doesn't reapply. customers in EU paying attention — I'd prefer manual rollback so we can coordinate release notes and cust comms.
tim: ops-run standing by to execute. if we go manual I can: 1) pin router 2) drain canary nodes 3) roll traffic back 4) hold autoscaler. ping me when decision is made.
maria: Agree manual. we don't want an automatic revert mid-change-window without comms. Plan: quick staged unwind. Steps: - pin version on routing 
  curl -X POST "https://routing.redwood.internal/pin" -d '{"version":"v3.6.5","ttl":"2h","reason":"canary-p95-spike"}'
  (ops-run will run this)
- route 30% back to v3.6.5 for 10m, monitor p95 & errors
- if healthy, full 100% cutover and unpin; open incident ticket with notes for customers + update release notes to mark rollback and mitigation
maria: assigning tasks: @tim execute pin + staged traffic, @leo validate metrics during slice, @ashley draft short customer blurb and update release notes, I'll own postmortem skeleton and notify sales.
leo: will watch p95 and kvcache miss ratio. i'll also grep the logs for the kernel flag rollout: `rg "kvcache" /var/logs/canary/*.log | head`
ops-run: ready. scheduling maintenance window hold and will pause autoscaler before pin. executing only after explicit approve from lead (maria).
ashley: drafting comm: "We observed elevated latency in canary for v3.7.0 related to a kvcache kernel toggle. We're rolling back to v3.6.5 while we investigate. No customer-facing downtime expected." i'll paste full text soon. :memo:
maria: approve to proceed? I'll wait 30s for objections.
leo: approve.
tim: executing pin and 30% route now. posting updates.
ops-run: pin complete: request id r-9f3a2, 30% traffic switch initiated at 5789054342. monitoring.
leo: p95 trending down to 1.2s at 30% slice, error_rate back to 0.06%. kvcache miss ratio falling.
maria: good. tim, proceed to 100% after 10m if stable. ashley, paste comm when ready and I'll send to sales + infra customers.
ashley: pasted customer note to #customer-comms draft channel and updated release-notes draft. link: https://docs.redwood/rel-notes/drafts/v3.7.0-rollback
maria: thanks everyone. follow-up: open an incident ticket and tag research for kernel flag regression analysis. I'll create the postmortem template.
leo: logging command and snapshot saved: `kubectl logs -l app=canary --since=30m > /tmp/canary-5789054321.log`
maria: thread closed once postmortem is created. :white_check_mark:
